fields.description: Selvara 4 brings four-bedroom villas to Grand Polo Club & Resort, with gardens, shared leisure spaces and access to the wider equestrian community. The phase-four launch comprises 173 homes. Its published plans offer four villa styles with different internal and outdoor area allocations.

overview: The Selvara 4 brochure describes a restrained palette of natural textures, pale stone and wood detailing. Community spaces include a neighbourhood park, play areas and a pool terrace, while the wider green core brings together the clubhouse, polo fields and stables. The relationship between each villa and these shared spaces varies by plot; marketing illustrations do not establish a guaranteed view.
research.locationNote: Selvara 4 sits within Grand Polo Club & Resort in Dubai. The brochure's map references Al Maktoum International Airport, Expo City and The Oasis. Review actual access roads and the selected home's position within the neighbourhood before assessing everyday journey times.
research.priceNote: Emaar currently displays prices from AED 7,113,888 for its published selection. The same page retains a historical AED 6.4m headline; the Selvara 4 fact sheet records a launch starting price of AED 6.43m. A fresh quotation is needed for the particular villa and payment position.
research.paymentNote: The launch schedule allocates 80% before completion and 20% at completion. Payments from March 2027 onward are tied to construction milestones. Historical dates show the original programme and may not match the amounts due on a later purchase.
research.handoverNote: May 2029 is the estimated completion month in the phase-four payment document and Property Finder. Confirm the current construction programme and contractual handover arrangements separately.

facts.label: Separate phase-four collection
facts.value: 173 four-bedroom villas, with average launch BUA of 3,805 sq ft and average plot area of 3,495 sq ft. These are collection averages, not minimum areas or available stock.

facts.label: Space across three floors
facts.value: The B Style 3 plan has a ground-floor guest bedroom, living/dining area, kitchen and service spaces; three bedrooms occupy the first floor. A second-floor lounge opens to terraces. Published totals combine suite, carport and balcony/terrace areas.

facts.label: Plan range versus marketed selection
facts.value: The complete pack ranges from 3,638.52 to 3,832.27 sq ft. The official page displays a narrower rounded size range for its current selection; it does not replace the full collection's plans.

facts.label: Availability distinction
facts.value: Property Finder marks the developer release out of stock while Emaar displays a priced selection. Confirm availability directly rather than relying on either cached status.
